Path 2, observabilityGOALS §4.2

OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions

Standard span attributes for model and tool calls.

WHAT IT IS

OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI (model, token counts, operation, tool calls), so model traffic lands in the same traces as everything else.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Being standardised now, with Google and Microsoft pushing a joint effort. Using it means our spans won't need rewriting when the standard settles. Claude Code can export OpenTelemetry telemetry.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt for every Claude and MCP call from day one: it's the inventory of what we use AI for. ⚠️ Pin a convention version; some attributes are experimental.

"The Race to Standardize AI Observability" (Google, Microsoft), KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT
